# Nature assets

Author: Quaternius
Pack: Ultimate Stylized Nature Pack (May 2022)
Official pack page: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatestylizednature.html
Official download folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1IV3bXHzkNvuNWFHPi4KPx-G4ghuxIuT-
License stated on the official pack page: CC0 1.0.
License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Models included: NormalTree_1.fbx, NormalTree_3.fbx, BirchTree_2.fbx,
Bush.fbx, Grass_Large_Extruded.fbx.
Textures included: corresponding bark, leaf and grass textures; bark normal maps.
Texture copies have been reduced to a maximum of 1024 px for this game.
No claim of authorship over these source assets is made.

License.txt is the unmodified license text from the pack's download folder.
Its heading says "Ultimate Platformer Pack", apparently a reused author template;
the official Nature pack page independently identifies this pack as CC0.
